rationale: The description lists conventional lesson, assessment, reporting, identity, permissions, and branding functions, but “Smart groups” is unexplained and could denote more than ordinary grouping; the binary negative is therefore weak.
evidence_spans: Build, share and track unlimited lessons. Quizzing and Surveys. Insights and Reporting.
User Management with Smart groups. User roles and permissions.
conflict_response: The two proposals agree on non_ai, but that agreement is not evidence. The labeler's supported reading overlooks the unexplained “Smart groups” cue; I retain non_ai only as a weak forced decision because the rest of the listed functions are conventional and the description does not establish AI.
